mapper.select: SELECT r.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org_member m WHERE m.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND m.role_id = r.id AND m.status = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0) AS member_count FROM workspace_role r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.id
SELECT * FROM workspace_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM workspace_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = #{code} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_role (tenant_id, code, name, active_name_key, access_level, read_only_domains, creator_id, modifier_id, version, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{name}, #{accessLevel}, #{readOnlyDomains}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_role SET name = #{name}, active_name_key = #{name}, read_only_domains = #{readOnlyDomains}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE workspace_role SET is_deleted = 1, active_name_key = NULL, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
